Lakrimae.description: <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Typhus'</style> <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> add <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style> to the target's hex. During his turn, when a non-mechanical enemy unit within Typhus' <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura is killed, he summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalker</style></style> in the hex of the defeated unit, as long as there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Poxwalkers on the battlefield. The Poxwalkers have <style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style> and <style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>.
